config.memoryModeMode1: Mode 1 — Fragment Memory (fast retrieval, simple scenarios)

config.memoryReviewDesc: The LLM will review all memories one by one, removing junk and merging duplicates. This may take a while, please be patient.
config.supervisorModeHelp: Experimental second runtime; not the interview main story. LLM mode plans and supervises organization tasks with a model. Compatibility mode uses single-pass routing without a Supervisor model call.
config.supervisorEndpointHelp: Auto locks the highest-priority healthy text endpoint when each new organization task starts. An explicitly selected endpoint fails clearly if it is deleted, disabled, or unavailable; it is never silently replaced.
config.ctxMaxWindowHelp: Global context window cap (tokens). Effective value = min(this, endpoint limit). 0 = unlimited
config.ctxCompressionRatioHelp: Target ratio for compressing early conversation. Lower = more aggressive (0.05~0.5)
config.ctxCompressionThresholdHelp: Start compressing when context reaches this fraction of hard limit (0.5~0.95)
config.ctxBoundaryRatioHelp: Compression ratio for old topic after topic switch (0.05~0.5)
config.ctxMinRecentTurnsHelp: Minimum recent conversation groups to keep during compression (4~20)
config.ctxEnableToolCompressionHelp: Independently compress oversized tool results via LLM
config.ctxLargeToolThresholdHelp: Compress tool results exceeding this token count
config.ctxLongTaskHint: Defaults are friendly to long-running work: task-level limits are off unless you opt in. Click Save after editing.
config.ctxLongTaskPresetSaved: Switched to long-task preset, click Save to apply
config.unrestrictedPresetSaved: Reverted to unlimited defaults — click Save to persist
config.strictPresetSaved: Switched to strict mode (with progress timeout & supervisor) — click Save to persist
config.presetHint: Default is unlimited; strict mode brings back the legacy guardrails (CI/batch jobs).
config.ctxHardTerminateRatioHelp: Only allow termination when input+output tokens reach this fraction of the model context window (0.5~0.99). Higher = more permissive. Suggested 0.95~0.98
config.ctxAnomalyThresholdHelp: When a single LLM call's input+output exceeds this, force a compaction. Won't terminate as long as actual context still has headroom. Suggested 80000+
config.ctxAnomalyMaxRecoveriesHelp: A compaction that succeeds in lowering pressure does NOT consume a slot. Only post-compaction over-threshold counts. Suggested 3~5
config.ctxTaskBudgetHint: Real-user sessions default to 0 = unlimited everywhere. Set non-zero only for programmatic guardrails (CI/SDK/unattended).
config.ctxTaskBudgetToolCallsHelp: Max tool calls per task. 0 = unlimited (default). Suggested 100~300
config.ctxSameToolLimitHelp: Max times the same tool with the same arguments may run in one task. 0 = unlimited (default). Suggested 8~12
config.ctxReadonlyHardLimitHelp: Force-terminate when read-only exploration (read_file/grep/list_directory etc.) goes this many rounds with no new info. 0 = never terminate (default). Suggested 10~15
config.ctxProgressTimeoutHelp: Kill the agent if it makes no tool calls / status changes for this duration. 0 = disabled (default). Suggested 1200
config.ctxHardTimeoutHelp: Absolute upper bound for total task wall-clock time. 0 = disabled (default). Final safety net only.
config.ctxSupervisorEnabledHelp: When enabled, intervenes/terminates on tool thrashing / edit thrashing / reasoning loops. Off by default; useful for strict unattended jobs.
config.ctxAdvancedHint: These directly affect compaction policy and the actual API request body size. Wrong values can make context tighter, not looser.
config.ctxRealUsageDecayHelp: Decay factor when calibrating local estimate with the previous turn's real input_tokens (0.1~1.0). 1.0 = trust real value fully, 0.1 = mostly use local estimate. Suggested 0.85~0.95
config.ctxBoundaryRatio2Help: After a topic switch, old topic is compressed to this fraction of original. Lower = more aggressive (0.05~0.5)
config.ctxCompressionRatio2Help: Early conversation is compressed to this fraction of original. Lower = more aggressive (0.05~0.5)
config.ctxCachedSummaryCharsHelp: Max characters per cached/aggregated tool-result summary. Larger = more detail kept, smaller = more token savings
config.ctxToolResultsTotalCharsHelp: Total character budget for all tool results in one turn before they hit context. Heavy-tool long tasks can raise this
config.apiToolsSchemaBudgetHelp: Token budget for the tools schema sent to the LLM API. Excess tools are auto-deferred (visible in catalog only, promoted on demand)
config.ctxReadonlySoftLimitHelp: How many read-only rounds with no new info before nudging the model (does NOT terminate). 0 = no nudge (default). Suggested 3~5
config.ctxTaskBudgetTokensHelp: Total LLM tokens a single task is allowed to spend. 0 = unlimited (default)
config.ctxTaskBudgetDurationHelp: Max wall-clock seconds per task. 0 = unlimited (default); 600 = 10 min. When 100% is reached, the budget auto-renews if there were any tool calls / token output in the last 60s — it only pauses when there's truly no progress.
config.ctxTaskBudgetIterationsHelp: Max ReAct iterations per task (effective = min with Max Iterations). 0 = unlimited (default); suggested 100~300
config.ctxTaskBudgetCostHelp: Max accumulated LLM call cost per task (estimated from token pricing). 0 = unlimited (default)
config.agentMinIntervalHelp: Minimum time between two proactive messages
config.agentIdleThresholdHelp: Proactive messages trigger only after user is idle for this long

config.toolsVisionHelp: Vision model for screen understanding and element location

agreement.title: Risk Acknowledgment
agreement.subtitle: Please read the following carefully before proceeding
agreement.content:
NewsClaw is an AI Agent software powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). Before using it, you need to understand and accept the following:

1. Behavior Is Not Fully Predictable
The AI Agent's behavior is driven by underlying LLMs, which produce probabilistic and non-deterministic outputs. Even with identical inputs, the Agent may produce different results, including but not limited to: unexpected file operations, unintended messages, and unintended tool invocations.

2. Supervision Is Required
You are responsible for supervising the AI Agent's actions at all times. For tool calls that require approval (such as file deletion, system command execution, message sending, etc.), review the operation details carefully before approving. It is strongly recommended NOT to enable auto-confirm mode without active supervision.

3. Potential Risks
The AI Agent may cause: data loss or corruption (e.g., accidental file deletion, overwriting important data), sending inappropriate messages (e.g., incorrect content through IM channels), executing dangerous system commands, generating unexpected API calls and costs, and other unforeseen side effects.

4. Disclaimer of Liability
NewsClaw is an open-source software project provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The project maintainers and contributors shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of this software. You assume all risks associated with using this software.

5. Data Security
Your conversation content, configuration data, and tool call records may be sent to third-party LLM service providers. Do not share sensitive personal information, passwords, keys, or other confidential data in conversations unless you fully understand and accept the associated risks.
